powers: You may recharge a weapon (☐ or any boon) to succeed at your check to recharge a spell (☐ then you may shuffle the recharged spell into your deck instead).
When you encounter a card, you may recharge a spell or an armor to draw a card.
When you succeed at a check to defeat a bane (☐ or to acquire a boon that has the Magic trait), you may examine the top card of your deck; if it is Magus Arcana, you may recharge a spell to draw it.

roles.name: Bladebound
powers: You may recharge a weapon (☐ or any boon) to succeed at your check to recharge a spell (☐ then you may shuffle the recharged spell into your deck instead).
When you encounter a card, you may recharge a spell or an armor to draw a card (☐ or to draw 3 cards, keep 1, and recharge the rest).

When you succeed at a check to defeat a bane (☐ or to acquire a boon that has the Magic trait), you may examine the top card of your deck; if it is Magus Arcana (☐ or a weapon), you may recharge a spell to draw it.
☐ When you would discard a weapon for its power, you may put Magus Arcana (☐ or a spell) on top of your deck instead.
☐ For each weapon in your discard pile, add 1 to your (☐ or any character at your location's) Melee check.

roles.name: Myrmidarch
powers: You may recharge a weapon (☐ or any boon) to succeed at your check to recharge a spell (☐ then you may shuffle the recharged spell into your deck instead).

☐ You may reveal Magus Arcana to reduce damage dealt to you by 1 (☐ 2).
